title: Iraq Devalues IQD Amid Parliamentary Opposition
detail: Iraq announced a devaluation of the Iraqi dinar (IQD) exchange rate, sparking debate within parliament. Some MPs have voiced opposition to the adjustment, citing concerns over its economic impact on ordinary Iraqis and import costs. The move reflects ongoing tensions between the government's economic policy goals and parliamentary stakeholders over currency management.

media.caption: Iraq devalues its currency amid parliamentary opposition over IQD exchange rate
